Visit note | 2025-12-28 02:00 PM | Dr. Shahadat Hossain, ENT | Patient: Parvez Islam, 42, male. Mr. Islam presents for his first visit complaining of painful swallowing and a sore throat. He explains that these symptoms began after shouting at a cricket match in Banani. He works as a garment merchandiser and has no significant past medical history. He denies cough, earache, or shortness of breath. On examination, his temperature is 102.0°F, BP is 119/70 mmHg, pulse is 110 bpm, and weight is 81 kg. The oropharynx shows inflamed tonsils with mild exudate. Assessment: Acute tonsillitis. Plan: a prescription was issued for symptomatic relief and infection control. He was advised to gargle with warm salt water, eat soft food, and drink plenty of fluids. Follow-up is scheduled in 1 week.
